# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 13 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Size — 9 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #22121f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #22121f | Cards, sheets, nav bar, inputs. Always sits on bg. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 800 44px/44px Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-wordmark); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wordmark` | `.wordmark`, `--text-wordmark` | 44px / 44px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | Tindi wordmark on login. |
| `title-lg` | `.title-lg`, `--text-title-lg` | 30px / 34px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | Screen titles and recipe name. |
| `title-md` | `.title-md`, `--text-title-md` | 24px / 28px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | App bar titles, error headline. |
| `title-sm` | `.title-sm`, `--text-title-sm` | 20px / 24px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | Sheet titles, empty-state headline, Step n of 5. |
| `cook-step` | `.cook-step`, `--text-cook-step` | 31px / 37px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | Cooking view instruction. Largest text in the app. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 16px / 24px | 500 | `sans` | Ingredient rows, inputs, buttons (weight 700). |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 500 | `sans` | Descriptions, source text, helper copy. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 700 | `sans` | Chips, tabs, card meta titles. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 13px / 18px | 600 | `sans` | Meta lines, field labels, counts. |
| `nav-label` | `.nav-label`, `--text-nav-label` | 12px / 16px | 700 | `sans` | Bottom navigation labels. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `Sora, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Chip gaps, tight stacks. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Card inner gaps, button icon gap. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding, grid and list gaps use 14px to 16px. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Screen side margin on every screen. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Sheet padding, section gaps. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Large empty-state gaps. |

## Size

Touch and component dimensions in dp. Minimum touch target is 48.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--touch-min: 48px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--touch-min), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--touch-min` | 48px | Minimum tappable size. Applies to every icon button, tab and row action. |
| `--button-h` | 56px | Primary and secondary buttons, text fields, search bar. |
| `--chip-h` | 44px | Category chips in the filter row. |
| `--nav-h` | 80px | Bottom navigation bar. Indicator pill 64 by 32. |
| `--fab-h` | 56px | Extended FAB, sits 20px from the right and above the nav bar. |
| `--icon` | 24px | All icons, 2px stroke, round caps and joins. |

| `--hero-h` | 230px | Recipe screen hero height. |
